name: Bayterek Tower
description: Observation tower and symbol of Astana with panoramic views over the capital's government quarter and the Ishim River.

name: Khan Shatyr Entertainment Center
description: A giant translucent tent housing shops, a sand-beach water park and family entertainment, open all year round.

name: Hazrat Sultan Mosque
description: One of the largest mosques in Central Asia, combining Kazakh and classical Islamic architecture in the centre of Astana.

name: National Museum of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Large museum with halls on the history, archaeology and ethnography of Kazakhstan, including the Golden Man collection.

name: Burabay National Park
description: Pine forests, granite rocks and clear lakes in northern Kazakhstan, popular for hiking, boating and lakeside resorts.

name: Big Almaty Lake
description: A turquoise alpine reservoir in the Ile Alatau mountains, a short drive from Almaty and a favourite photography spot.

name: Shymbulak Ski Resort
description: The main ski resort above Almaty with cable cars, groomed slopes and mountain restaurants at around 2,200 metres.

name: Medeu High-Mountain Skating Rink
description: A famous open-air ice rink in a mountain valley above Almaty, reached by a long stairway or by car.

name: Charyn Canyon
description: A 90-kilometre red-rock canyon with the Valley of Castles, formed by erosion over millions of years.

name: Kolsai Lakes
description: Three alpine lakes in spruce-covered mountains, reached by trekking and horse riding trails from the village of Saty.

name: Lake Kaindy
description: A mountain lake with a sunken spruce forest whose bare trunks rise out of the water, formed after a landslide in 1911.

name: Altyn-Emel National Park
description: Desert national park with the Singing Dune, ancient petroglyphs and colourful Aktau and Katutau mountains.

name: Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi
description: A 14th-century UNESCO-listed mausoleum in Turkestan, an important Sufi pilgrimage site with a vast unfinished dome.

name: Tamgaly Petroglyphs
description: A UNESCO-listed canyon with thousands of Bronze Age rock carvings and ancient sanctuaries near Almaty.

name: Green Bazaar Almaty
description: A lively covered market selling dried fruits, spices, horse-meat delicacies, honey and Korean-style salads.

name: Panfilov Park and Ascension Cathedral
description: A green park in central Almaty with the colourful wooden Ascension Cathedral and a war memorial.

name: Kok-Tobe Hill
description: A hilltop leisure area reached by cable car, with city views, cafes, a small zoo and an amusement park.

name: Aksu-Zhabagly Nature Reserve
description: Kazakhstan's oldest nature reserve in the western Tien Shan, known for wild tulips, canyons and rare wildlife.

name: Aral Sea Region
description: A journey to the shrinking Aral Sea and the ship graveyard, a stark landscape that tells a story of environmental change.

name: Katon-Karagay National Park
description: Altai mountain park with alpine meadows, glacial rivers and trekking routes towards Mount Belukha.

name: Aktau Caspian Waterfront
description: The beaches and promenade of Aktau on the Caspian Sea, a base for desert and canyon excursions in Mangystau.

name: Registan Square
description: Three monumental madrasas with blue-tiled facades at the heart of historic Samarkand on the Silk Road.

name: Bukhara Old City
description: A well-preserved old town with domed bazaars, mosques and the Lyab-i Hauz pond, a living museum of Silk Road life.

name: Itchan Kala
description: The walled inner city of Khiva with its turquoise minarets, palaces and narrow lanes, an oasis city on the Silk Road.

name: Chorsu Bazaar
description: Tashkent's biggest traditional market under a blue dome, famous for plov, fresh bread, spices and dried fruit.

name: Issyk-Kul Lake
description: One of the largest alpine lakes in the world, with beaches, hot springs and lakeside resorts surrounded by snow peaks.

name: Ala-Archa National Park
description: A glacier-carved valley near Bishkek with day hikes and mountaineering routes into the Tien Shan.

name: Song-Kol Lake
description: A high-altitude lake surrounded by summer pastures where visitors can stay in a yurt and ride horses.

name: Fann Mountains
description: Remote Tajik mountain range with turquoise lakes and multi-day trekking routes far from the crowds.

name: Tbilisi Old Town
description: Cobbled streets, carved balconies, sulphur baths and wine cellars in the Georgian capital.

name: Hagia Sophia
description: A sixth-century Byzantine masterpiece in Istanbul with a vast dome, former cathedral and mosque.

name: Grand Bazaar Istanbul
description: One of the oldest and largest covered markets in the world, with thousands of shops selling carpets, ceramics and gold.

name: Cappadocia
description: A region of fairy chimneys and cave hotels, famous for sunrise hot-air balloon flights over rock valleys.

name: Konyaalti Beach
description: A long pebble beach in Antalya with turquoise Mediterranean water and the Taurus mountains as a backdrop.

name: Pamukkale Travertine Terraces
description: White calcium terraces filled with warm thermal water above the ruins of the ancient spa city of Hierapolis.

name: Burj Khalifa
description: A record-breaking skyscraper in Dubai with high-level observation decks, fountains and a huge shopping mall at its base.

name: Petra
description: The rose-red city carved into canyon walls by the Nabataeans, reached through a narrow gorge called the Siq.

name: Dead Sea Shore
description: The lowest point on land, where mineral-rich water and black mud treatments attract visitors seeking relaxation.

name: Giza Pyramids
description: The last surviving wonder of the ancient world, with the Great Pyramid, the Sphinx and desert camel rides.

name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
description: Marrakech's main square, transforming at dusk into an open-air kitchen with food stalls, musicians and storytellers.

name: Eiffel Tower
description: The wrought-iron landmark of Paris with viewing platforms and a nightly sparkling light show.

name: Louvre Museum
description: The world's most visited art museum, home to the Mona Lisa and thousands of works from antiquity to the 19th century.

name: Colosseum
description: The vast amphitheatre of ancient Rome where gladiator contests were held, in the middle of the Roman Forum area.

name: Vatican Museums
description: Papal art collections including the Raphael Rooms and the Sistine Chapel with Michelangelo's ceiling frescoes.

name: Sagrada Familia
description: Gaudi's unfinished basilica in Barcelona, with forest-like columns and spectacular stained glass.

name: British Museum
description: A free-entry museum in London with world-famous collections including the Rosetta Stone and Egyptian mummies.

name: Santorini Oia
description: Whitewashed cliffside village overlooking the volcanic caldera, famous for its sunsets and blue-domed churches.

name: Amalfi Coast
description: A dramatic coastline of lemon terraces, pastel villages and seafood restaurants south of Naples.

name: Jungfraujoch
description: The Top of Europe: a rack-railway journey to a glacier saddle with ice palace and Alpine panoramas.

name: Hallstatt
description: A tiny lakeside village in the Austrian Alps with a historic salt mine and some of Europe's most photographed views.

name: Blue Lagoon Iceland
description: A geothermal spa of milky-blue water set in a black lava field, close to Keflavik airport.

name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
description: A Shinto shrine in Kyoto with thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up a forested mountain.

name: Shibuya Crossing
description: Tokyo's iconic scramble crossing surrounded by neon screens, department stores and nightlife.

name: Mount Fuji and Kawaguchiko
description: Japan's highest mountain viewed from the Five Lakes area, with hiking in summer and onsen towns year-round.

name: Ubud
description: Bali's cultural heart with rice terraces, yoga studios, art galleries and wellness retreats.

name: Patong Beach
description: Phuket's busiest beach with water sports, restaurants, nightlife and easy day trips to nearby islands.

name: Yaowarat Road
description: Bangkok's Chinatown, which turns into one of the world's great street-food destinations after dark.

name: Maldives Atolls
description: Coral atolls with overwater villas, lagoon snorkelling and private-island resorts in the Indian Ocean.

name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
description: The grandest of Seoul's Joseon-era palaces, with a changing-of-the-guard ceremony and traditional hanbok rentals.

name: Machu Picchu
description: A 15th-century Inca citadel high in the Andes, reached by train or the multi-day Inca Trail.

name: Banff National Park
description: Canada's oldest national park, with turquoise glacial lakes, skiing, hiking and wildlife in the Rocky Mountains.

name: Great Barrier Reef
description: The largest coral reef system on Earth, offering diving and snorkelling trips from Cairns and the Whitsundays.

name: Central Park
description: An 843-acre urban park in Manhattan with lakes, walking paths, a zoo and open-air performances.

name: Serengeti National Park
description: Vast savannah famous for the great wildebeest migration and classic safari encounters with big cats.
